content: {"like": ["The film takes a look at Wyatt Earp’s checkered past leading up to the events at the OK Corral.","Wyatt Earp’s character is not whitewashed and is portrayed as a complex, imperfect man.","The reviewer highly recommends the film as an epic of the American West and a fascinating version of the events surrounding the famous shootout.","The reviewer also recommends other related films such as Blake Edwards’ *Sunset*.","The reviewer appreciates the director John Sturges’ earlier films about the same events."],"dislike": ["The reviewer despises director John Ford’s film *My Darling Clementine* for its ridiculous portrayal.","The reviewer finds Frank Perry’s *Doc* to be a depressing mess."]}
